name: pi-git-bash-only
description: Enforce Git Bash as the only shell for pi on Windows: hard-block powershell/pwsh/cmd calls, inject shell policy into the system prompt, verify shell configuration, and install wmicu + gbk (GBK to UTF-8 wrappers for native exe output).
